# Campaign direction statement (candidate B) — CAMPAIGN-VISIBLE

DIRECTION (not a posed problem): quantum contextuality as a computational resource.
The field has strong kinematic formulations (graph-theoretic and otherwise) and
scattered operational advantages. The direction's ambition: identify NEW, preferably
UNCONDITIONAL, operational advantages conferred by contextuality — and quantify them
by the structures that formulate contextuality itself.
